getId].issue: Malformed operationId on GET /apisix/admin/stream_routes/{id}; 200 response is an untyped object and 404 is undocumented.
getId].actual: Single stream route lookup returning StreamRouteEnvelope (404 when missing); canonical id getStreamRoute.
getId].evidence: Spec v3.19.0 operationId == "getId]". Verified against the APISIX 3.19.0 source shipped in the apache/apisix image (apisix/admin/resource.lua): _M:get returns the single etcd node envelope, and the 404 status of a missing key.

putId].actual: Create-or-replace stream route by id; canonical id putStreamRoute.

deleteId].actual: Delete stream route by id; canonical id deleteStreamRoute.

notes.detail: Consumers are created/replaced with PUT on the collection; the identity is the `username` property in the body, not a path segment.
The request body is any JSON value (scalar, array or object) that replaces the value at the slash-separated sub_path.
Responds with a plain string body rather than a JSON object.
Secrets and plugin_metadata endpoints declare 200 responses as untyped objects (or inline schemas); DTOs for them are derived from the request schemas and examples.
HEAD /apisix/admin (operationId ping) is unauthenticated and returns 200 with no body.
